title: Fix flaky AS2 compiler tests: dowhile and staticclass (~25% failure rate)
description:
Two test files in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/ fail intermittently (~2 out of 8 cold runs, ~25%) with non-deterministic errors:

1. dowhile.test.ts — 'do-while emits ActionJump (0x99)' — containsByte(bytes, ACTION_JUMP) returns false sporadically. Suggests the compiled bytecode varies between runs (non-deterministic instruction ordering or compiler state leakage).

2. staticclass.test.ts — tests 2 and 6 — a parse error ('expected punctuation "(", got "get"') and a byte-check assertion failure. The parse error suggests a shared parser/lexer state being left dirty between tests (global mutable state in tokenizer or parser).

Root cause hypotheses:
- Shared mutable state in the AS2 tokenizer, parser, or compiler (e.g. a module-level counter, symbol table, or label map not reset between test runs).
- Non-deterministic Map/Set iteration order affecting instruction emission order.
- Test file ordering dependency (test B passes only if test A ran first).

Fix approach:
- Run the two failing files in isolation AND in combination to isolate ordering dependency.
- Audit packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts, parser.ts, tokenizer.ts for any module-level mutable state (global label counters, cached parse results, singleton instances).
- Make each test self-contained: any shared state must be reset in beforeEach().

Acceptance: both test files pass reliably across 10 consecutive cold runs (pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run --reporter=verbose).
